Staff agreement of the Albrecht Edition

Project agreement · Version 1.1 · 21 October 2026
Academies Association · Overall coordination Eva Brandt

This agreement applies to all contributors with access to the internal editions. It describes the obligations of the contributors and the commitments of the Academies Association. The data protection information, rights system and the archive concept are included; they are made available and explained before work starts.

V01 · Rule

1. Working together and preserving the emergence

We use Git for cooperation, comprehensible versions, troubleshooting and protected preservation of our work history. Accesses to work areas, integration, publication and archive are allocated separately. Before the first productive contribution, the work path, the applicable rules and contact persons are explained.

File contents, previous versions, commit messages, identifiers and timestamps can remain permanently comprehensible. The removal in the current text does not remove older versions. Work history will not automatically become public with the end of the project.

V02 · Rule

2. Identification, contribution and scientific responsibility

You work under your own stable pseudonymous project identifier. Identifications are not passed on or reused. The institutional identity register is managed separately protected. Also pseudonymous histories remain personal; from professional contributions, assignments can be identified.

The technical execution is distinguished from scientific responsibility and professional acceptance. Your contributions are appropriately identified in TEI metadata and contribution proofs after the documented activities. Git author or Git committer alone does not decide on scientific authorship.

V03 · Rule

3. Contributions, rights of use and publishing links

The rights attachment determines for each contribution, which processing, integration, archiving and publication is permitted and which attribution applies. A commit does not grant a general public permission to use it. Rights of third parties are not granted by this agreement.

Who brings in foreign material, names source, well-known rightholders and conditions. Unclear cases remain in the designated protected area. Publisher PDF, comment, text data and images are released separately. No one publishes internal repos, exports or screenshots independently.

V04 · Rule

4. Care and help

The released Git manual regulates the daily work. Check changes before the commit and use the intended reviews. Passwords, private messages and personnel issues do not belong in Git, tickets or XML comments. Technically necessary vulnerable information receives a suitable access area.

If you have accidentally uploaded confidential data, please contact the responsible service immediately – even if you have already changed the file. Messages are first used to limit damage. Shared history is not secretly rewritten or wrongly attributed to posts. Necessary interventions coordinate the editorial team with the competent authorities.

You may not make available to unauthorized persons any current git stands or Git history. Protect local repos including the .git directory, exports and stored access data through shared device encryption, screen lock, and personal accesses. Do not use unreleased approvals or synchronization services.

Report possible unauthorized access to IT and project coordination immediately: for example, in the case of lost device or data carrier, exposed token, accidental folder sharing or suspicion of a copied history. Do not wait for proof of a data outflow. IT locks accesses and coordinates further measures with the competent authorities.

V05 · Rule

5. Troubleshooting, process analysis and free time allocation

The reconstruction of a faulty site is part of the agreed troubleshooting process. A new regular or comprehensive analysis needs a written analysis sheet, information from the team and the required institutional examination and participation. It names question, data, method, access, recipients, deadlines and excluded uses.

Commit numbers, change quantities and daily hours are not used for individual performance evaluation, attendance control or rank formation. Storage times are not proof of working hours.

Appropriate quality and progress standards are developed with the team. No automatic personnel decisions follow from measurement values. Security or legal incidents run in a separate, narrowly limited procedure; they do not allow general personnel monitoring.

V06 · Rule

6. Who sees the data

The role overview mentions who is allowed to read, administrate, perform approved analyses and receive reports. Technical access does not grant an additional evaluation permit. Expert reporters and publishers receive the agreed test packages or production data, no general accesses to the internal work history.

New analysis tools and external AI/Cloud services are checked for rights, transmission and protection prior to integration. This agreement does not allow the precautionary transmission of all repos to third-party services.

V07 · Rule

7. Archiving and subsequent research

The Academies Association passes released results and protected work stories separately to its scientific archive. Results data and methods are made publicly accessible in the legally released scope. Protected accesses apply to process holdings.

Subsequent research at the origin of the edition will be decided after documented application, legal examination and protection examination. Research access is not approval for evaluation of former employees or for publication of personal profiles. This agreement does not contain any general consent to any future research use.

V08 rule

8. Rights, Storage and Objections

The data protection information lists the responsible bodies, legal bases, recipients, storage purposes and rights. Applications for information, correction, deletion or restriction are examined by the data protection authority in accordance with the legal requirements. These rights are not abandoned by a signature.

Git clones, backups and archival copies are taken into account in the implementation. Technical difficulties are not a general reason for rejection. Measures, remaining limits and decisions are explained and documented.

Questions and objections can be addressed to Eva, the data protection office or the employee representation without any discrimination. The receipt is confirmed within five working days; legal processing periods remain decisive.

V09 · Rule

9. Quitting, changing roles and changing rules

When leaving, tasks are handed over, accesses are terminated and local collection are deleted or institutionally taken over under the guidance of IT. Contributions and legally preserved history remain in accordance with the respective rules; existing rights remain.

The change from the core team to an associated institution or to another task triggers a new check before the new access: Which responsibility remains, which collection are needed and which agreement applies now? Old rights are withdrawn before the appropriate new rights are established. Further work with the previous account scope does not take place automatically.

A temporary exception for further accesses or local copies is documented by the overall coordination, agreed with IT and the bodies responsible for rights and data protection and expressly released. It specifies the purpose, collection, protective measures, responsible person, expiration date and final control. Legal and contractual limits remain binding; an exception is not a flat-rate permission to retain all data.

Manual changes are announced and explained. They do not extend any agreed usage purposes. New purposes or further data access require a separate examination and regulation. Taking note confirms the information; it does not replace any required legal basis or participation.

The mandatory installations

Data protection information

The institutions involved document their responsibility, legal bases per purpose, recipients, storage and review rules as well as rights of data subjects and means of complaint. The data protection authority keeps and updates this information.

Rights and publication installation

The right/publication office carries out the contribution, scope of rights, source/third-party rights, license, attribution and publishing conditions per subject. Missing rights block the relevant approval.

Archive and research access concept

The scientific archive documents acquisition, protection requirements, retention decision, access criteria, application procedures and treatment of later interested parties. Procedural records are evaluated before the takeover; access remains dedicated.

Analyzer and Git Manual

The analytical system concretizes each released study. The manual describes the current daily practice; its current version and introduction are documented.

Who else works with the data?

The edition also includes employees of the typesetting service provider, the IT and the publisher as well as external experts. They have different tasks and need different data. An employee agreement for the core team does not automatically cover these relationships. Agreements can be concluded with the participating institutions or service providers; they must actually record their authorised contributors and the permitted uses.

Albrecht therefore runs a participation and access directory. For each party there are institution, task, responsible contact, required repos or data packets, access to history, local copies, valid agreement and end/examination date. Parties are grouped together into appropriate groups; however, permissions are awarded per task and person. A contract with a service provider does not mean general Git access for its entire workforce.

Prior to each entry and when changing roles or institutions, access will be re-matched. This also applies when switching from the core team to an associated institution. Responsibility, agreement, training, shared devices and copies must match the new task. The appropriate contractual and data protection rules are determined according to the actual relationship; not every external access is the same type of service.

Albrecht's access groups and regulations
Core team / Bandredaktionen

Access: Required working repositorys and related protected history

Regulation: Employee agreement, manual and role sharing

Associated entities

Access: Delimited areas of work according to cooperation task

Regulation: Cooperation and access arrangements; designated contributors

IT and technical operation

Access: System rights required for operation and incidents

Regulation: Operational/service arrangements, confidentiality and limited administration tasks

typesetting service provider

Access: Tested production packages; no general access to work history

Regulation: Contractual handover, correction, security and copy arrangements

Publisher/Lectorate

Access: Agreed delivery stands and return channels

Regulation: Publication contract and supplementary data/access rules

External expert

Access: Fixed test deduction or separate protected test range

Regulation: Confidential review order with scope, return channel and end of access

The path to Git participation
  1. Task, Party and Required collection
  2. Examine appropriate agreement and responsibilities
  3. Training: Git, Handbook, Safety and Reporting Routes
  4. Release and document personal limited rights
  5. Recheck, change and complete in the case of roll changes, time limits or exit
